item.title: Exeunt 0.3.3
item.description:
A Linux and Windows beta that brings Eos shutdown to Linux.

What’s new

  • Eos on Linux. exeuntd eos finds Eos Primaries and follows the one you choose.
  • Quit Exeunt on Windows. The tray menu now ends with Quit Exeunt.
  • Licence stopping shutdowns? exeuntd triggers and eos now say so.
  • Help. help, -h and --help now work on every exeuntd command.

Good to know

Quit closes the tray only: shutdowns still work. The Start menu reopens it.

Help and questions: support@flatfield.co

item.title: Exeunt 0.3.0
item.description:
A beta with two new ways to shut down: OSC and text commands.

What’s new

  • Shut down over OSC. QLab or Companion can send /exeunt/shutdown/<key>.
  • Shut down with text. Crestron or Q-SYS can send exeunt shutdown <key>.
  • Triggers. Every way to shut down is in one place, each with its own switch.
  • Eos names. Primaries show their Eos names, and yours has a tick.

Good to know

OSC and Text stay off, with ports 9193 and 9194 closed, until you turn them on.

Help and questions: support@flatfield.co
